title: HelperSessionTargetResult
description: A minted, one-shot target (nocx-6q1uh.5, spec §6.2): a signed token a caller presents back to session.intent to spend it, and the id session.intent-status polls by without ever re-transmitting the signed value.

token.description: The whole signed target, opaque to the caller.

tokenId.description: Names the same target without exposing its signature: 32 lowercase hex characters, the same 16-raw-byte convention a host session id already uses.

expiresAtMs.description: Unix milliseconds after which this token verifies expired.
